name: userland
description: Build, publish and run apps for your business on Userland: skills for each step, and the Userland connector to do it.

interface.shortDescription: Build and publish apps for your business
interface.longDescription: Describe the app your business needs, and Codex builds it and publishes it on Userland: booking pages, forms, client portals, invoices and more. Skills cover building an app, its saved data and sign-in, publishing, secret keys, fixing errors, undoing a change, custom domains, and your Userland account. Secret keys are never typed into the chat.
defaultPrompt: Build and publish an app for my business on Userland
